title: Decorate Challenge

items.text: Premade cupcakes; frosting and decorations of your choice; spreading tools, plates and wipes.
Paper liners, a card base, tissue paper or cotton balls for frosting, markers or stickers, glue. Glue the base into the liner, add the frosting, then decorate.

items.title: Everyone adds an idea
items.text: Each student names or sketches one decorating idea.

items.title: Plan and roles
items.text: The team agrees one design that keeps part of each idea, and picks roles: Leader, Supply Manager, Timekeeper, Clean-Up Crew.

items.title: Decorate together
items.text: Teams follow their plan. Food route: wash hands first.
Keep decorations closed until you have checked the team’s plan.
Each person names one part of their idea that must stay.

items: Cupcakes that show part of every member’s idea.
